start.text: Day eight. The last day of the week. At 14:30, the phone rings.
start.name: Joshua

B.text: IT desk, this is Joshua. How can I help?
B.name: Joshua

C.text: Joshua? It's Sam, the web developer. The customer portal is showing strange errors, and two orders came in that nobody placed.
C.name: Sam

D1.text: A typing mistake does not place an order. But I do not know what else it could be.
D1.name: Sam

E1.text: Possible. Evidence first. Let us see what was typed.
E1.name: Joshua

D2.text: Around 14:00. The errors go up every minute.
D2.name: Sam

F.text: Then we look at the web logs, the accounts and the database. What was typed, and what the site did with it.
F.name: Joshua

G.text: [b][color=green]5 clues[/color][/b] should be enough. Then I run two queries side by side and show what happened.
G.name: Joshua
